topic: AI Invents Faces of Non-Existent People
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

AI can conjure up brand-new human faces so realistic, they look like photos, but that person has *never* existed!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 AI creates faces of people who have literally never lived.
🔹 It uses Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to learn from millions of real pictures.
🔹 GANs invent unique faces, complete with expressions and details.
🔹 It's almost impossible to tell these AI-generated faces apart from actual humans.
🔹 This shows AI isn't just copying data, but creatively generating entirely new realities!
